copy.headline: R&B star Jhené Aiko sets Fort Worth date on 2027 arena tour
copy.caption:
Fort Worth 📍

R&B star Jhené Aiko sets Fort Worth date on 2027 arena tour

R&B singer Jhené Aiko will embark on an expansive arena tour, Ark to Agartha - A Westside Whimsy Experience , in 2027, which will include a stop at Ariat Arena in Fort Worth on Tuesday, April 20.

📍 Fort Worth, TX

Follow @FortWorthTexasTV for more 📲
